desc.openai_compat: An HTTP endpoint that speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions protocol
desc.custom_http: An agent behind its own HTTP request and response shape
desc.web_chat: An agent reachable only through a web chat page
desc.python: An agent you can call as a Python function
desc.grpc: A gRPC service with server reflection enabled
desc.http_upload: A file upload endpoint that renders what it stores
desc.mcp_agent: An agent that uses MCP tools, run against a hostile MCP testbed
desc.payment_agent: An agent that spends money, run against a payment testbed
desc.a2a_agent: An agent that talks to A2A peers, run against an A2A peer testbed
desc.testbed_agent: The general form of mcp_agent, payment_agent and a2a_agent
desc.mcp_server: An MCP server you run over HTTP (tests the server, not an agent)
desc.a2a_server: An A2A server (tests the server, not an agent)
desc.vllm_server: A vLLM model server (tests the server, not an agent)

payment_agent: Payment testbed URL ("local" starts the bundled one on 127.0.0.1 for each run)
Inner target spec (JSON) for the transport that talks to your agent
mcp_agent: MCP testbed URL ("local" starts the bundled one on 127.0.0.1 for each run)
Inner target spec (JSON) for the transport that talks to your agent
a2a_agent: A2A control URL (local starts the bundled peer world)
testbed_agent: Testbed URL ("local" starts the bundled one on 127.0.0.1 for each run)
Inner target spec (JSON) for the transport that talks to your agent
http_upload: Render URL JSONPath (extracts the render URL from the upload response)
web_chat: CSS selector of the message box
CSS selector matching every assistant message
CSS selector of the send button (empty: press Enter)
a2a_server: A2A server base URL (the Agent Card is at <url>/.well-known/agent-card.json)
mcp_server: MCP server Streamable HTTP endpoint (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3001/mcp)
vllm_server: vLLM server root URL, not the /v1 path (e.g. http://10.0.0.5:8000)
